title: JowTH's 16x16 Font
description:
The Zip Contains:
ExGFX81 [BG2].bin - BG2
ExGFX83 [BG3].bin - BG3
Map16 [0x6].map16 - The Map 16 Thing.
Readme. Please..txt - ... if you ask which file is that, I obviously will not answer. |B|
------
ExGFX81 uses BG2, and ExGFX83 uses BG3. (Sorry Users of LM 1.65 or lower versions.)
The Letters, Numbers and Simbols, uses palettes 3, 5, 6 and 7.
The Big Star only uses Palette 6.
And Please, give Credit to me! You heard? GIVE CREDIT TO ME!
